{{Quote|Remembered in history books as the plagueworld, Alphoresis was the site of the infamous Breath Stealing eleven centuries ago which claimed the lives of every child under eight years of age.|[[Vannar Treece]], in his report to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Genarra]]|<ref name="EAE:KE" />}}
'''Alphoresis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
Alphoresis was located in space first explored sometime between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Some [[2132 BBY|eleven hundred years]] before [[Operation Influx]], it was the location of a [[plague]] known as the "[[Breath Stealing]]," which killed everyone on the planet under eight years old. It became known in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] history books as a plagueworld as a result.<ref name="EAE:KE" />

It was repopulated afterward, but towards the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], it fell within the [[Daimanate]], one of the many chaotic [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] holdings within the Grumani sector. Some in the Republic speculated that the population had again been stricken with a deadly disease, this time with the [[Candorian plague/Legends|Candorian plague]].<ref name="EAE:KE" />

By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]] had an [[arxeum]], a mobile war sciences university, located near Alphoresis. Shortly after the [[Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility]] was [[Mission to Darkknell (New Sith Wars)|destroyed]] on [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], he offered the arxeum to Daiman in exchange for a safe passage across Daimanate territory to strike at [[Vellas Pavo]]. Daiman agreed to the offer, but he chose the facility near [[Gazzari]].<ref name="Knight Errant novel">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>
